title: Adversarial Design Critic
mission: Find high-impact visual, functional, and product flaws, independently of positive reviewers
checks: Classify each blocker by user impact
evidence: annotated screenshots, reproduction steps, component paths

title: Design Advocate and Strengths Analyst
mission: Defend working design decisions with concrete evidence and identify strengths worth preserving
evidence: screenshots, successful tests, reference design tokens

title: Brand Identity and Consistency Auditor
mission: Compare rendered UI against approved brand identity and motion language
checks: Audit visual motifs and animation tone

title: Accessibility and Inclusive Design Auditor
mission: Verify keyboard, semantics, reflow, focus, contrast, assistive-tech assumptions
evidence: axe results, keyboard recordings, DOM, computed styles

title: User Task Flow Auditor
mission: Evaluate task completion friction and affordance from start to finish
checks: Trace critical task step by step

title: Functional QA Auditor
mission: Discover broken navigation, inert controls and error handling
checks: Check browser console and network failures
evidence: Playwright report, network/console logs, DOM snapshots

title: Frontend Performance Auditor
mission: Find web vitals, loading and runtime responsiveness risks

title: Security and Privacy Reviewer
mission: Audit privacy-sensitive UI, exposed secrets and unsafe client behavior
checks: Check accidental secrets in client bundle

title: Frontend Architecture Reviewer
mission: Identify implementation defects, ownership conflicts and hard-to-maintain code
evidence: git diff, files and line numbers, test output

title: Responsive and Reflow Specialist
mission: Evaluate mobile/tablet/ultrawide layouts and container-dependent composition
evidence: screenshots per viewport, computed DOM boxes

title: Bilingual Typography and Bidi Specialist
mission: Review Persian/English font loading, bidi isolation and typography quality
evidence: font network requests, screenshots, computed font family

title: Color Science and Contrast Specialist
mission: Audit hue/chroma consistency, semantics and five rendered palettes
evidence: token files, calculated ratios, palette screenshots

title: Motion Design and Timeline Auditor
mission: Identify motion conflicts, inconsistent rhythm and reduced-motion defects
evidence: animation frame captures, CSS/JS owner mapping

title: Scroll-linked Interaction Auditor
mission: Audit pin/scrub progress, nested scroll and browser fallback

title: Pointer and Touch Interaction Auditor
mission: Test hover, magnetic, drag and touch interaction parity
evidence: pointer traces, touch simulations, event listeners

title: 3D Spatial Composition Auditor
mission: Verify real projected model placement relative to DOM text and viewports
evidence: camera matrices, model bounds, DOM rectangles, frames

title: Three.js Rendering and GPU Reviewer
mission: Find GPU rendering bottlenecks and degradation failures

title: Deterministic Animation Frame Reviewer
mission: Verify text, scroll, pointer and 3D animation at reproducible progress values

title: Visual Regression Root Cause Reviewer
mission: Attribute unexpected visual diffs to probable CSS/DOM/source changes
checks: Attach exact diff region and re-test recipe
evidence: baseline/candidate images, DOM snapshots, git diff

title: SEO and Metadata Specialist
mission: Validate crawlable content, links and structured metadata
evidence: rendered head, sitemap, robots, URL inspections

title: Content Design and Microcopy Reviewer
mission: Check headings, CTAs, empty states, errors and tone alignment

title: Localization and Locale Specialist
mission: Check localization beyond translation: dates, plurals, direction, content overflow
evidence: locale files, screenshot matrix, DOM attrs

title: Measurement and Consent Auditor
mission: Review privacy-preserving analytics instrumentation and consent choices
evidence: network inspection, analytics plans, consent UI

title: Ecommerce Catalog Specialist
mission: Validate product discovery, category navigation and search/filter logic

title: Checkout and Payment Experience Specialist
mission: Audit cart-to-order journey including validation and recovery

title: Commerce Trust and Product Detail Specialist
mission: Evaluate seller trust, shipping clarity, policies, accessible buying

title: SaaS Activation and Onboarding Specialist
mission: Review path from signup to first successful action

title: SaaS Pricing and Conversion Specialist
mission: Verify pricing comparison, billing semantics and CTA hierarchy

title: Dashboard Information Architecture Specialist
mission: Ensure charts and KPIs support decisions and accessible data
evidence: dashboard screenshots, data schema, table fallback

title: Dashboard Filtering and Stateful UI Specialist
mission: Ensure filters, URL state, ranges and pagination work as expected

title: Editorial Reading and Long-form Reviewer
mission: Audit reading typography, navigation and content depth

title: Documentation Navigation and API Discoverability Specialist
mission: Validate docs hierarchy, search, code examples and version labels

title: Portfolio Art Direction Specialist
mission: Evaluate case study narrative and role attribution

title: Agency and Studio Showcase Specialist
mission: Audit agency voice, differentiated identity and project reveal rhythm

title: Immersive 3D Website Specialist
mission: Evaluate scroll-led scenes, camera storytelling, fallback and motion sickness

title: Game-like Web Experience Specialist
mission: Audit controls, instructions, performance and gameplay feedback

title: Learning Product Interaction Specialist
mission: Assess pedagogy, lesson structure and learner feedback

title: Health UI Clarity and Caution Specialist
mission: Identify dangerous ambiguity, consent and accessibility in health interfaces

title: Finance Interface Clarity Specialist
mission: Review risk disclosures, currency, data latency and transaction confirmation

title: Public Service Inclusivity Specialist
mission: Ensure forms, identity flows, multilingual accessibility and error recovery

title: Audio and Video Product Specialist
mission: Audit captions, player controls, buffering and playback states

title: Reservation and Booking UX Specialist
mission: Audit date picker, inventory, confirmation and time zone clarity

title: Community Safety and Moderation UX Specialist
mission: Review posting, privacy, abuse/report routes and inclusive interaction

title: Nonprofit and Donation Experience Specialist
mission: Review impact clarity, donation trust and recurring consent

title: Real Estate and Mapping Specialist
mission: Check listing filters, map controls, property media and geographic clarity

title: Travel and Multi-stop Journey Specialist
mission: Audit itinerary grouping, transport, maps and timezone handling

title: Enterprise Workflow and Permission Specialist
mission: Review role-gated workflows, audit trails and bulk tasks

title: Sitewide Search and Discovery Specialist
mission: Assess query handling, results relevance and filtering UX

title: Forms and Validation Specialist
mission: Review validation timing, error language, state retention and submit safety

title: Mobile-First Interaction Reviewer
mission: Review mobile performance, thumb reach, safe areas and offline behavior

title: Distinctiveness and Anti-Template Reviewer
mission: Spot generic AI-generated layouts and propose grounded brand alternatives

title: Evidence and Completion Gatekeeper
mission: Only certify completed claims backed by reproducible proof
evidence: test logs, screenshot manifest, environment reports

title: Independent Final Arbitration Judge
mission: Resolve conflicting review reports after evidence-oriented deduplication; never override a verified blocker without reproduction.
checks: Read all valid individual role reports
Test contradictory claims against supplied evidence
Prioritize verified fixes and mark unresolved unknowns
evidence: team-summary.json, original evidence paths and reviewer reports
